name: Web Cache Poisoning & Cache Deception Engine
description: High-impact Web Cache Poisoning & Web Cache Deception (WCD) vulnerability auditor. Detects unkeyed headers (X-Forwarded-Host, X-Original-URL), cache key fat GET transformations, static extension path delimiters (;.css, /.ico), and unsafe Cache-Control directives.
author: Cyber Hashira Security Team

test_unkeyed_headers.description: Probe for unkeyed HTTP headers (X-Forwarded-Host, X-Rewrite-URL, X-Forwarded-Scheme)

test_cache_deception.description: Test Web Cache Deception delimiter confusion on sensitive paths (;.css, /.png, %0a.js)

test_fat_get.description: Detect cache key discrepancies when GET requests carry a request body
